page_title: Candy AI: AI Girlfriend App | Chat w/ Pics, Voice, & Video

sources.entry: Candy.ai - Your dream companion awaits! Create your Virtual Girlfriend, shape her personality and bring her to life in one click. 100% powered by Artificial Intelligence. #freemium

summary.name: Candy AI
summary.one_liner: Candy.ai is a web-based AI companion service where users chat with pre-made or custom-built virtual girlfriend and boyfriend characters via text, voice, images and video.
use_cases: language practice and social skill rehearsal
summary.what_it_does: Candy.ai lets users chat with over 100 pre-made AI characters, including AI girlfriend and AI boyfriend personas. The companions can hold voice conversations, generate personalized images, and appear in AI-generated video. A "Create My AI Girlfriend" builder lets users pick ethnicity, age range, eye and hair features, body features, personality, voice and hobbies. The page says the characters remember user preferences and adapt their tone over time. Access is through subscriptions (free trial, monthly, quarterly, yearly) that come with tokens for voice, chat, image and video, and the page says more detailed characters use more tokens.
notable: Chat, voice, image and video interaction with one companion
Custom character builder with personality, voice and hobby options
Accepts Visa, MasterCard and crypto (BTC, ETH, USDC, Litecoin)
caveats: Uses tokens; more detailed companions and features consume more tokens, and additional tokens must be topped up
Paid subscriptions (monthly, quarterly, yearly) after the free trial; the page does not state prices
Characters are AI and interactions are described as fictional; the page notes it is not a replacement for professional care
